app.title: PrimerCheck Lite
app.summary: A person sets the reaction chemistry, then pastes a forward and reverse primer and, if they have one, a template sequence. They set a minimum, a maximum, both or neither for each screening metric and run the analysis. They read headline melting temperatures and a warning count, a per-primer table that marks each metric as within range or needing review, a list of warnings, and an exact-match check for one product on the template. They then download the results as JSON or HTML, together with the limits they used.

task.text: Screen an existing primer pair against limits the person sets, so they know which sequence and thermodynamic values need a closer look before bench work.

data.text: Two short DNA sequences (a primer pair), an optional longer template sequence, reaction-condition settings, and a set of editable acceptance ranges per metric; the output is a table of computed metrics with a status for each, plus warnings.
data.item: a forward and reverse primer pair, written 5′ to 3′

stage.text: checking an existing primer pair before ordering or running PCR at the bench

mechanism.text: Sidebar and form inputs (chemistry, sequences, per-metric ranges) feed one analyze action. Its result is split into headline metric cards and tabs for per-primer tables, review warnings, the template check and report downloads. Every metric is judged against the editable ranges.

field.text: in silico PCR and qRT-PCR primer screening in molecular biology

workflow.name: check a candidate against configurable acceptance limits and export a report

steps.step: set the conditions the computation depends on
steps.here: Sidebar number inputs for monovalent salt, magnesium, dNTP and primer concentration feed the Primer3 melting-temperature and structure estimates
Paste the forward and reverse primers 5′ to 3′, and optionally a template in FASTA format; headers and spaces are stripped, U becomes T, and non-ACGT characters are rejected
For every metric, tick 'Set minimum' and/or 'Set maximum' and type the limit, starting from teaching defaults; an error appears if the minimum is above the maximum

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: 'Analyze primer pair' computes length, GC %, Tm, hairpin, homodimer and heterodimer Tm, longest homopolymer, 3′-end GC count and the Tm difference

steps.step: flag the values outside the limits
steps.here: Each metric is marked 'Within range' or 'Review'; a warnings tab lists every out-of-range value along with its configured range, and a card shows the warning count

steps.step: check the pair against a reference
steps.here: Searches the template for the forward primer and the reverse complement of the reverse primer facing inward; reports a unique product with its coordinates and length, no product, or several (ambiguous)
Download a JSON report, a standalone HTML report, and the threshold settings as JSON

distinctive: Thermodynamic estimates depend on reaction chemistry the person enters, so the same primers can score differently under different buffers
Metrics are judged per primer and also for the pair (heterodimer Tm and Tm difference between the two primers)
Each limit can be a minimum, a maximum, both or neither, and a value out of range is presented as 'needs review', not as a failure
The template check uses exact matching in an inward-facing orientation and is explicitly not a genome-wide specificity search
The limits used are exported separately, so they can be recorded alongside the experiment
